```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- Rendering + root resolution (the load-bearing chunk — see the notebook-exploration
#     skill's references/root-resolution.md before "simplifying" any of it) ------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      # crisper, more compact figures; ragg_png is a headless raster device
                      # (no X11) so this renders on the container and commits real PNGs.
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "80%",
                      dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 150)
options(bitmapType = "cairo")   # any bare png()/ggsave() in a chunk also stays headless-safe

# This notebook only READS what the stage wrote — it never computes anything a later stage
# leans on. Resolve the compartment root by (1) the notebook's own dir when knitr/quarto
# knows it (render), else (2) walking up from the wd to a sentinel (interactive line-by-line).
# Bind here() to the resolved root — NOT getwd() — so source()/readRDS() work whether this is
# knitted, quarto-rendered, or pasted into radian from any directory.
.find_root <- function(sentinel = "02_analysis/config/analysis_config.yaml") {
  start <- tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) NA_character_)
  if (is.na(start) || !nzchar(start)) start <- getwd()
  d <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = FALSE)
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, sentinel))) {
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(parent, d))
      stop("compartment root (", sentinel, ") not found above ", start,
           "\n  -> launch radian from inside the compartment, or render via notebooks/render.R")
    d <- parent
  }
  d
}
.root <- .find_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = .root)   # render pass runs from the compartment root
if (interactive()) setwd(.root)          # line-by-line runs agree with render
here <- function(...) file.path(.root, ...)   # anchored to root, never getwd()
```

```{r libs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(knitr) })
# Re-plot live from the checkpoint/tables through the project style, so this review always
# reflects the current config rather than a baked-in PNG. Canonical publication figures still
# live in 03_results/[stage]/figures/ (written by the numbered viz script).
source(here("02_analysis/helpers/figure_style.R"))
```
